body.name: Total guarded fixed-frame plug-in estimator
body.construction: Fix \(\theta^{\circ}\) before sampling. From \(\widehat m\), first form the polynomial matrix \(\widehat H\) and continue only if \(\sigma_{\min}(\widehat H)>\kappa_H/2\). On that branch compute the canonical realization and \(\widehat{\bar K}_0\), continuing only if \(\sigma_{\min}(\widehat{\bar K}_0)>\kappa_0/2\). Next compute \(\widehat{\bar B}_a\) and \(\widehat V_F\), continuing only if \(\sigma_{\min}(\widehat V_F)>\kappa_F/2\). Then form \(\widehat c\) and \(\widehat L\), continuing only if \(\sigma_{\min}(I_K-\widehat L)>\tau_N\), \(\min_{(g,r)\in\mathcal G}\widehat p_g>\kappa_p/2\), every other inverse not protected by a declared fixed gap has smallest singular value greater than \(\tau_N\), every remaining scalar denominator in the ATT and influence formulas has absolute value greater than \(\tau_N\), and the computed marginal influence variances exceed \(\kappa_V/2\). On the final pass branch, evaluate the ATT, covariance, studentization, and multiplier critical value by their displayed plug-in formulas. At the first failed gate, return \(\widehat\theta=\theta^{\circ}\), \(\widehat\Sigma=I_{|\mathcal G|}\), unit standard errors, and critical value \(1\). Ties take the fallback branch. This sequential piecewise rule is a total Borel map \(f\).
